description: Check an external plugin source of a plugin for a new version and preview the update, changing no item: `upToDate`, else per kind the items to `add`, those that `change` (status changed, conflict, edited, other_source or unowned), the `unchanged` ones and those the new version no longer has (`remove`), with the `previewId`, `sourceFingerprint` and `fingerprint` plugins_external_update takes as decisions. An external plugin imported from a URL is checked by its URL; an uploaded one needs `path`. `plugin` is required.

path.description: Folder of the new version of an uploaded external plugin, resolved against the project root (CLI: --path); an external plugin imported from a URL is checked by its URL.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin). Required.

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

pluginSource.description: The external plugin source: its id, or its name when the plugin has one source of that name (see plugins_external_sources).

name: plugins_external_update_preview
title: Preview external plugin update
